rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for illuminating something or making a place visible.

example.english: A streetlamp can light up the whole street at night.
example.traditional: 夜晚盞街燈照亮成條街。
example.jyutping: je6 maan5 zaan2 gaai1 dang1 ziu3 loeng6 seng4 tiu4 gaai1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for visible light and brightness.

example.english: I pulled open the curtains, and there was light in the room right away.
example.traditional: 我拉開窗簾，房入面即刻有光。
example.jyutping: ngo5 laai1 hoi1 coeng1 lim4 fong4 jap6 min6 zik1 hak1 jau5 gwong1

rows.note: Use 輕 as the all-purpose adjective for low weight, and also when “light” means gentle or low in intensity.

example.english: This bag is really light, so carrying it all day won't make me tired.
example.traditional: 呢個袋好輕，拎住行成日都唔攰。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 doi6 hou2 hing1 ling1 zyu6 haang4 seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 gui6

rows.note: Use this for a physical light or lamp as a source of illumination.

example.jyutping: ni1 zaan2 dang1 gau3 m4 gau3 gwong1 aa3

rows.note: Use this when starting a fire, rather than when something merely catches fire.

example.english: When camping, we need to light a fire to cook.
example.traditional: 露營嗰陣我哋要生火煮食。
example.jyutping: lou6 jing4 go2 zan6 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sang1 fo2 zyu2 sik6

rows.note: Use this specifically for traffic lights, including the traffic-light location in directions.

example.english: You’ll get there after the traffic light.
example.jyutping: gwo3 zo2 hung4 luk6 dang1 zau6 dou3 laa3

rows.note: Use this when something catches fire or becomes ignited by itself.

example.english: The rubbish bin suddenly caught light, so we immediately ran away.
example.traditional: 個垃圾桶突然著火，我哋即刻走開。
example.jyutping: go3 laap6 saap3 tung2 dat6 jin4 zoek6 fo2 ngo5 dei6 zik1 hak1 zau2 hoi1

rows.note: Use 光 as the all-purpose adjective for a room or place that is bright rather than dark.

example.english: The room is so light that we don't need to turn on the light.
example.jyutping: gaan1 fong2 gam3 gwong1 m4 sai2 hoi1 dang1

rows.note: Use 輕鬆 when a task or duty is easy and not demanding.

example.english: This homework is light and easy to do; I'll finish it in a little while.
example.traditional: 呢份功課做起上嚟好輕鬆，我一陣就做完。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gung1 fo3 zou6 hei2 soeng6 lei4 hou2 hing1 sung1 ngo5 jat1 zan6 zau6 zou6 jyun4

rows.note: Use 淺色 for a pale or light-coloured shade, such as light clothing or light skin colour.

example.english: I want to buy a shirt in a light colour, so it won't feel as hot in summer.
example.traditional: 我想買件淺色恤衫，夏天着冇咁熱。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 gin6 cin2 sik1 seot1 saam1 haa6 tin1 zoek3 mou5 gam3 jit6

rows.note: Use this for an insight or enlightening revelation rather than ordinary physical light.

example.english: This book shed light on something I had never understood.
example.traditional: 呢本書畀咗我一個重要啟示。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 bei2 zo2 ngo5 jat1 go3 zung6 jiu3 kai2 si6
